t2.thesis: MXL enters a very volatile print (implied move about 26%) after a huge run, with high expectations offset by strong guidance momentum, so the direction is close to a coin flip.
reasons: Implied move of ~26% is huge, so the outcome is dominated by the surprise versus a high bar rather than by base rates
Stock is up ~330% over 12 months but down 13% over the last month and 41% below its 52-week high, so expectations are elevated but already partly reset
Q3 guide of $210-220M versus Q2 $168.8M and a 90-day estimate rise of about 48% show a strong fundamental trend that is likely already priced in
Last 4 prints had a 50% win rate with beats each time, so beats alone did not guarantee a positive open-to-open move
Chip stocks were weak on AI investment worries in mid-October, a mild headwind
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and optical AI/Keystone DSP commentary versus the whisper number after the big run
